# Answer: Green

The next color the stop light in front of the bridge will turn after the truck backs up and turns left is **green**.

What the video shows, stated explicitly:

- The video is the 11foot8 bridge strike. A white box truck drives toward the bridge, strikes the bridge, and gets stuck under it with its roof peeled open.
- The truck remains stuck under the bridge for many seconds. It then backs out from under the bridge toward the camera side and turns left, driving out of the intersection to the left. In video time this backing starts around 76-78 seconds and the left turn completes around 80-84 seconds. In the second camera's embedded timestamps this is approximately 16:08:18 to 16:08:24, after which the truck has left the frame and the video cuts to the outro.
- The stop light tracked here is the three-lamp vehicle signal visible in the close-up view at the upper right, mounted beyond the bridge and facing the camera. It is also visible as the pair of red lights at the upper right in the wider MI view after the camera switch.
- Dense sampling of that signal shows its normal cycle explicitly. It is green at about 66-68 seconds of video time, with the bottom lamp lit. It is yellow at about 69-72 seconds, with the middle lamp lit. It is red from about 73-74 seconds onward, with the top lamp lit.
- The truck is still stuck and stationary while that green-to-yellow-to-red change happens. The backing and left turn both happen later, while the signal is already red. At 73, 74, 76 and 78 seconds the signal is red and the truck is still under or just starting to back out. At 80, 82 and 84 seconds the signal is still red while the truck is turning left and leaving.
- Therefore immediately after the truck has backed up and turned left, that stop light is red.
- The observed order in the video is green, then yellow, then red. The standard continuing order after red is green. No additional green-yellow-red cycle for that approach is shown after the truck leaves before the video ends.

So the light is red after the maneuver, and the next color it will turn is green.
